Authentication API

Overview Authentication Users

Introduction

This document describes how to authenticate against the Example API using various client libraries.

Login Endpoint

POST https://api.example.com/v1/auth/login

Request


{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "securePassword123"
}

Response


{
  "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
  "expires_in": 3600,
  "refresh_token": "dGhpcy1pcy1hLXJlZnJlc2gtdG9rZW4="
}

Example: Node.js (deprecated)

The following example uses the request package, which is no longer maintained.


// File: /src/auth/login.js
const request = require('request'); // request@2.88.2 (deprecated)

const options = {
  url: 'https://api.example.com/v1/auth/login',
  method: 'POST',
  json: true,
  body: {
    email: 'user@example.com',
    password: 'securePassword123'
  }
};

request(options, (error, response, body) => {
  if (error) {
    console.error('Request failed:', error);
    return;
  }
  if (response.statusCode !== 200) {
    console.error('Login failed:', body);
    return;
  }
  console.log('Access token:', body.access_token);
});

Example: Node.js (modern)

Replace the deprecated code with axios version 0.27.2.


// File: /src/auth/login-axios.js
const axios = require('axios'); // axios@0.27.2

(async () => {
  try {
    const response = await axios.post(
      'https://api.example.com/v1/auth/login',
      {
        email: 'user@example.com',
        password: 'securePassword123'
      },
      {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
      }
    );
    console.log('Access token:', response.data.access_token);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Login error:', err.response ? err.response.data : err.message);
  }
})();

Example: Python


# File: /examples/auth_login.py
import requests  # requests==2.28.1

url = "https://api.example.com/v1/auth/login"
payload = {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "password": "securePassword123"
}
headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}

response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    print("Access token:", data["access_token"])
else:
    print("Error:", response.status_code, response.text)
